related.title: RACK-TLP：時間式重排序容忍
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受100/103.2作理論目標；完整實作驗收需額外檢查RFC其他規則。 交接時須能核對：交付 cubic-curve.csv、平臺附近圖與理論／實際視窗分欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept100/103.2 as theoretical targets; full implementation acceptance needs the remaining RFC rules. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver cubic-curve.csv, plateau plots and separate theoretical/actual-window columns.
related.difference: 記錄每段傳送時間、ACK時間及最近已交付段；本題只研究時間gate，不冒充完整RACK。
related.differenceEn: Record send/ACK times and the latest delivered segment; study only the time gate, not a complete RACK implementation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
CUBIC以距前次最大視窗的時間模型定義立方目標；實作還有TCP-friendly及ACK等約束。
教學基準：0.4*0**3+100 = 100 segments target；對照：0.4*2**3+100 = 103.2 segments target。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

RACK利用已確認資料的傳送時間推論遺失；重排序窗口避免把所有晚到封包當遺失。
教學基準：12-5 = 7 ms margin；對照：12-15 = -3 ms margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
CUBIC defines a cubic target around the previous maximum; implementations also include TCP-friendly and ACK constraints.
Teaching baseline: 0.4*0**3+100 = 100 segments target; comparison: 0.4*2**3+100 = 103.2 segments target. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

RACK uses transmission times of acknowledged data to infer loss; a reordering window prevents treating every late packet as lost.
Teaching baseline: 12-5 = 7 ms margin; comparison: 12-15 = -3 ms margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HTTP Range：閉區間與部分內容完整性
related.titleEn: HTTP Range: inclusive intervals and partial-content integrity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受100/103.2作理論目標；完整實作驗收需額外檢查RFC其他規則。 交接時須能核對：交付 cubic-curve.csv、平臺附近圖與理論／實際視窗分欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept100/103.2 as theoretical targets; full implementation acceptance needs the remaining RFC rules. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver cubic-curve.csv, plateau plots and separate theoretical/actual-window columns.
related.difference: 建立Range、Content-Range、ETag與實際body長度，避免把閉區間當半開。
related.differenceEn: Record Range, Content-Range, ETag and actual body length without treating inclusive ranges as half-open.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

CUBIC以距前次最大視窗的時間模型定義立方目標；實作還有TCP-friendly及ACK等約束。
教學基準：0.4*0**3+100 = 100 segments target；對照：0.4*2**3+100 = 103.2 segments target。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

HTTP byte range兩端為包含式；Content-Range及資源validator需對應同一表示。
教學基準：1999-1000+1 = 1000 B；對照：999999-999000+1 = 1000 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
CUBIC defines a cubic target around the previous maximum; implementations also include TCP-friendly and ACK constraints.
Teaching baseline: 0.4*0**3+100 = 100 segments target; comparison: 0.4*2**3+100 = 103.2 segments target. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

HTTP byte-range endpoints are inclusive; Content-Range and the resource validator must describe the same representation.
Teaching baseline: 1999-1000+1 = 1000 B; comparison: 999999-999000+1 = 1000 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
